disposition_reason: Tables 1-4 print mean ± SD Pb, Cd, Cu and Zn for meat, poultry, milk and dairy products, and Cd, Pb, As and Hg for freshwater fish, by district in three industrial regions of Kazakhstan.

study.design: Cross-sectional monitoring survey of meat, poultry, milk, dairy products and freshwater fish purposively sampled from technogenically hazardous areas (uranium and gold ore mining, heap leaching, metallurgy, former Semipalatinsk nuclear test site)
study.origin: Abai, Aksuat and Ayagoz districts (Abai region); Zerenda, Akkol, Bulandy and Shortandy districts (Akmola region); Abai, Bukhar-Zhyrau and Aktogay districts (Karaganda region); local water bodies of Akmola and Karaganda regions, Kazakhstan
study.market: Farms and food market stalls in Astana, Karaganda, Kokshetau and Temirtau
study.method: Dry ashing at 450 °C with HNO3, dissolution in HCl; ICP-OES (EXPEC 6500) for Pb, Cd, Cu, Zn; arsenic and mercury method not described
study.lod_text: Solution LOD/LOQ: Pb 0.010/0.0318 mg/L, Cd 0.001/0.00318 mg/L, Cu 0.003/0.00954 mg/L, Zn 0.002/0.00636 mg/L; solid samples LOD/LOQ: Pb 2.0/6.36 mg/kg, Cd 0.2/0.636 mg/kg, Cu 0.5/1.59 mg/kg, Zn 0.3/0.954 mg/kg
study.qa: QA/QC section describes radionuclide control samples (recovery 70-130%), blanks and duplicates; no CRM or recovery reported for metals

unresolved: Almost all reported Pb and Cd means (and many Cu and Zn means) are below the paper's own solid-sample LODs (Pb 2.0 mg/kg, Cd 0.2 mg/kg); each such finding carries an integrity_flag.
Arsenic and mercury are reported for fish (Table 4) but the Methods give no method or LOD for them.
Several SDs exceed their means (e.g. Karaganda Bukhar-Zhyrau horse meat Cd 0.216 ± 2.26 mg/kg; Abai region Aksuat horse meat Pb 0.230 ± 1.57 mg/kg).

Text and tables disagree in places: Bukhar-Zhyrau horse meat Pb SD (text 0.013, table 0.0013); Akkol lamb Cu SD (text 0.21, table 1.23); milk Cu MPC (text 0.1, table 1.0 mg/kg); text says mercury was found in fish from only two water bodies in Karaganda, while Table 4 also lists mercury in three Akmola samples.
Shortandy district appears in Table 1 under Akmola region but is not in the listed sampling districts; Bulandy appears only in Tables 2-3.
Table 4 lists 'Pike-perch' and 'Sander lucioperca' as separate rows although they are the same species.
Basis (wet or dry weight) is not stated.
Sample totals differ between the abstract (383 meat/dairy, 143 fish) and Methods (384 and 144).
Radionuclide results (Cs-137, Sr-90; Tables 5-6) are not heavy-metal findings and were not extracted.
